notes.title: Crimzon Clover - World EXplosion - v1.13f Update
notes.content:
Dear users,

We have some exciting news: With the newest update version [b]1.13f[/b], Crimzon Clover World EXplosion is now officially [b]"Deck Verified"[/b] title!

Now you can blast your way through the game on the go and be sure that it is going to play just as good as sitting at home on your PC!

So load it up on your Steam Deck, and have fun blasting away for a new high score.
We hope you continue to enjoy the game, good hunting everyone!

[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated controller glyphs to match Steam Deck controllers
[/list]

If you have any other feedback, please let us know.

Cheers,

Komodo team

notes.title: Crimzon Clover - World EXplosion - v1.13e Update
notes.content:
Dear users,

We've just released the latest version [b]1.13e[/b]: There have been some adjustments to provide an even better Steam Deck experience, as well as fixes to bugs reported by the players.

[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]When launching with Steam Deck, the screen resolution will be locked to "1280*720 borderless window" to prevent the game from not starting correctly. 
*Operation guide during replay, and the ranking screen will remain the same.
[*]Controller glyphs of Steam Deck are now appropriately displayed under "controller settings" when launching with Steam Deck.
[*] The key configurations will be initialized if a key config value does not exist in the Steam Deck.
[*] The issue that the screen size was wrong when launching with dual monitors, where one monitor was set to portrait and the other set to landscape" has been fixed. Due to certain constraints, full-screen will no longer be an option under this condition, but the borderless window can still be chosen.
[/list]
*Demo version has been updated as well.

If you have any other feedback, please let us know.

Cheers,

Komodo team

notes.title: Crimzon Clover - World EXplosion - v1.13 Update

We would like to thank everyone's support towards "Crimzon Clover World EXplosion!"

We hope you are enjoying it so far. We have just released the latest version 1.13, which includes bug fixes reported by the players!

[h2]Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the screen ratio would be incorrect when playing the game on a portrait monitor (Windows Display Settings -> Screen Orientation set to "Portrait").
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would subsequently become unplayable if you let the mid-boss go off-screen with the tip part remaining on the 4th screen of Arrange mode.

[/list]

*Please be aware that the configuration settings will be initialized with the update.
*Demo version has been updated as well.

If you have any other feedback, please let us know.

Cheers,

Degica Games team

notes.title: Regarding "Superplay Strategy Guide" and "Arcade Poster Pack"
notes.content:
Dear users,

Many of you might be wondering why we didn't release the same DLCs as before. As some might have noticed already, "Superplay Strategy Guide" and "Arcade Poster Pack" are included in the game folder already!

You should be able to find the files under the following folder
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Crimzon Clover World EXplosion

[h3]CCPosters[/h3]
Includes two different posters for the Crimzon Clover WORLD IGNITION.

[h3]commentary[/h3]
Includes the entire "Superplay Strategy Guide."

[b]Contents of the Super Replay Strategy Guide include:[/b]

16 high-scoring replays by the world's best Crimzon Clover superplayers, one for each major mode and ship type combination.  Examine their games to refine your own strategies!
[list][*]4 replays for Arcade Original Mode, featuring Type I,II,III and Z.  Demonstrations provided by superplayers GFA2-ISO, RETurn, and Makki. 
[*]4 replays for Arcade Boost Mode, featuring Type I,II,III and Z.  Demonstrations provided by superplayers SOGO, CAT_OOD and Amp_Dep.
[*]4 replays for the brutally challenging Unlimited Mode, featuring Type I,II,III and Z. Demonstrations provided by superplayers SELDIA and GFA2-ISO.
[*]4 replays for Time Attack Mode, featuring Type I,II,III and Z.  Demonstrations provided by superplayers TAKEYUKI, Gowasu, and GFA2-ISO.
[*]A special Super Replay section will be unlocked in-game, so you can view the replays at your convenience.[/list]

A 76-page strategy guide spanning 22 documents, including commentary and strategic insight by the superplayers to accompany each of the 16 replays that are included.  Pick up some tips from the pro players!
[list][*]Commentary by each player for each replay, featuring all mode and ship combinations (16 in all).
[*]4 documents providing an overview of the features, differences, and key strategic concepts of each Mode.
[*]2 enemy-type documents displaying illustrations of all the enemies and bosses in the game along with their base point values.  See which enemies give the big points![/list]

We hope that you will enjoy the definitive strategy guide for Crimzon Clover World EXplosion!!

notes.title: 『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』 Demo version updated
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo version of "Crimzon Clover World EXplosion".

Today, we've fixed most of the bugs reported in the demo version.
Please be assured that the bug fixes in the demo version will be carried over to the full version.

The updated contents are as follows

[list]
[*] ver1.10 -> ver1.11
[*] Config data from ver1.10 or earlier cannot be used (even if it exists, it will be forced to default settings)
[*] The ranking server initialization access at startup has been cut to speed up the process (demo version only).
[*] High refresh rate monitors are now supported.
[*] HD+ (1600*900)" has been added to the game resolution.
[*] Added "Borderless Window" to the window mode selection.
[*] When the window mode is "Window", the size of the window can be changed by dragging the edge of the window (same as WORLD IGNITION)
[*] Fixed some issues with the screen display.
[/list]

Please continue to let us know your thoughts and opinions, and if you haven't wishlist the game, go do it now because it's coming real soon!
